name: fabric-patterns
title: Fabric Patterns
description: Run Daniel Miessler's fabric patterns on your selection, a URL or a file. Search patterns, manage strategies, contexts, sessions, configs and chains. Requires the fabric CLI.
author: michaelhixon

commands.name: search
commands.title: Run Fabric Pattern
commands.subtitle: Fabric Patterns
commands.description: Find a fabric pattern, chain or session and run it. Enter runs it on your selection; Cmd+Enter opens the run form.

commands.name: browse
commands.title: Manage Fabric
commands.subtitle: Fabric Patterns
commands.description: Create, edit and organize custom patterns, strategies, contexts, sessions, configs and chains, and view the built-in patterns.

commands.name: update-patterns
commands.title: Update Fabric Patterns
commands.subtitle: Fabric Patterns
commands.description: Download the newest built-in fabric patterns (runs fabric --updatepatterns).

commands.name: background-runs
commands.title: Show Background Runs
commands.subtitle: Fabric Patterns
commands.description: See fabric runs started in the background, copy or paste finished results, or stop a running one.

preferences.name: fabricPath
preferences.title: Fabric Path
preferences.description: Absolute path to the fabric binary. Left at the default, it also finds Homebrew's Intel install at /usr/local/bin/fabric-ai; a path you type here is used as is.

preferences.name: defaultOutput
preferences.title: When a Run Finishes
preferences.description: Where the answer goes when a run finishes. The Run form can override it.

data.title: Copy to Clipboard + Save to File

preferences.name: saveFolder
preferences.title: Save Folder
preferences.description: Where saved results and background-run results are written. Paste or type a path; ~ and file:// URLs work.

preferences.name: longInputs
preferences.title: Long Runs (Web Pages, YouTube, Audio, Video)
preferences.description: How runs on a web page, YouTube, audio or video are handled.

preferences.name: customPatternsFolder
preferences.title: Custom Patterns Folder
preferences.description: fabric's Custom Patterns folder. Must match fabric's own setting (fabric --setup › Custom Patterns). Paste or type a path; ~ and file:// URLs work.
